To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) RL is more efficient than clustering, (ii) clustering is faster than RL and (iii) the combination of the two techniques is the most efficient approach for the assignment of queries in the proposed framework.

(a) the proposed RL model provides a better query assignment compared to the deterministic approach; (b) the proposed clustering scheme provides an efficient solution for the query assignment; (c) the proposed combination scheme that combines RL and clustering provides an efficient solution with a better performance than the individual ones.
